newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt bank proposing capital increase.
newsitem.headline: Egypt bank proposing capital increase.

text.p: The board of Suez Canal Bank said on Thursday it was proposing increasing the bank's capital and that it might do so through a public share offering.
The bank said in a published announcement it was considering raising the authorised capital to 500 million pounds from 100 million and also doubling the paid-up capital to 100 million pounds.
It also said that it wanted to transform its shares denominated in U.S. dollars into Egyptian pound stock.
The bank will hold an extraordinary general assembly on 21 June to approve the proposals.
